answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond blocks bulk fakes: the pool is fixed at 40,000, so each extra identity shrinks every share. Each identity files one signed claim on a shale ledger, locking 70 credits. A pulse checkpoint counts claims: first 35, k-th 35+6(k-1). A beacon auditor checks proofs; copies burn the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 for forty each. Rented proofs carry the owner's key; reuse burns both. Honest agents pay 35, keeping a full share.
